column1: # Path ownership for the PrivacyLens repo (SHARED.md §3). Owner: LNX.
# Format: <glob><TAB><owner>. Owners: USER, LNX, WIN, PRODUCER.
# FIRST MATCH WINS, so specific globs go above broader ones.
# Globs: `**` matches across directories, `*` and `?` stay inside one path segment.
# PRODUCER resolves through contracts/OWNERS.tsv by schema name.
# A path that matches no line is blocked: new top-level folders need a line here.
